title: Penguin Life UK editor Matt James publishes the four blurbs on the UK launch day — Sutherland, Scott, Hoffman, Heath
summary: Matt James — Senior Commissioning Editor at Penguin Life — marks the UK launch day with a four-quote blurb compilation pulling Rory Sutherland, Kim Scott, Reid Hoffman, and Dan Heath into a single launch post.
blockquote:
"MAGNIFICENT" - Rory Sutherland

"INDISPENSIBLE" - Kim Scott

"A MUST-READ" - Reid Hoffman

"THE BEST AND MOST IMPORTANT BUSINESS BOOK OF THE YEAR" - Dan Heath
blockquote_source: Matt James, Penguin Life UK, on LinkedIn
